description: Translate the Sky Fortress energy crisis and Knuckle Coast lead-in.

english:
Hey, Taiki...
If your Digimon
are low on HP
or MP, use a
Tent or the
healing bed on
the Sky
Fortress. A nap
there will get
everyone back
on their feet!
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
There should be
a request to
find the
Digimon Flight
Team. First,
accept it from
the Quest
Monitor.
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
The Quest
Monitor...?
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
It's the big
digital screen
in the
Commander Room.
Ask Palmon
beside it how
to use it.
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
Taiki can do
anything
perfectly! And
that thing you
called it?
Leave it to me,
too!
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
Woo! Brother!
So cool!
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
I-I want to
come, too! When
I'm with you,
Taiki... I feel
like I might
get back the
memories I
lost...
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
...Taiki, I
know this is a
lot, but please
look after
Spadamon! I'll
keep repairing
the system and
gathering data.
If you need
anything, I'll
be right here.
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
All right,
let's go!
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english: Mmm...
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english: Mmmph!
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english: Grrrr...
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
Why is everyone
standing here
grunting?
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
Oh, Taiki! You
came at the
perfect time!
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
We've been
waiting for
you, Taiki
Kudo!
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
Oh? What's
wrong? Is there
trouble, Akari?
I can lend a
hand, my head,
or my strength!
Whatever you
need, I'll do
it right now!
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
What's going
on, Zenjiro?
Patamon, what
happened?
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
...Starmon,
Shoutmon. Calm
down.
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
What's wrong,
Patamon?
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
I was checking
the Sky
Fortress
systems... but
there's not
enough energy.
The DigiLab and
DigiFarm can't
run any of
their important
functions.
Worse, unless
we get the
Capacitor
Towers working
soon, we'll run
out of energy
and the systems
will shut down.
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
The Capacitor
Towers?
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
They generate
this Zone's
energy. There
are six towers,
but it looks
like all of
them have
stopped. They
were working
fine before ROG
took the Sky
Fortress... Did
Minotaurmon
mess with
something?
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
They cut the
Sky Fortress's
power so they
could steal it!
This must be
part of ROG's
plan! What a
dirty trick!
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
But each
Capacitor Tower
has a huge
door, with the
Capacitor
System behind
it. Only the
tower's
administrator
should be able
to start it.
That's why ROG
has the area
around every
tower locked
down.
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
Who is the
administrator
of the
Capacitor
Towers?
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
I don't know...
The towers have
been locked for
ages. Patamon
and I once
tried to sneak
in, but the
door wouldn't
budge. We had
to go back in
tears... I
mean, that was
a long time
ago! I wouldn't
cry now!
Really!
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
But the system
behind those
doors shut
down, so the
energy stopped
flowing and the
towers stopped
working, right?
We have to
investigate the
Capacitor
Towers...
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
Yeah, something
may have
happened there.
Let's
investigate.
Where are the
Capacitor
Towers?
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
The closest one
is... let's
see... on the
edge of the
Energy
Continent, at
Knuckle Coast.
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
Ooh! That
sounds like a
tough place! I
can't wait to
get going!
blocks.review_note: Story, request, and system dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.
